quaere.definition:
v. imperative. Inquire; question; see; -- used to signify
   doubt or to suggest investigation.
quaere.translation:
vt. 请问, 查询
[法] 问题, 质问, 疑问; 查问, 询问

quaestio.translation: [法] 审问处, 问题, 询问

quaestor.definition: n any of several public officials of ancient Rome (usually in charge of finance and administration)
quaestor.translation: n. 刑事推事, 主管财务官吏
